request.description:
## Request body parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | Required. Must not be empty. | `Encrypt PII at rest` |
| `description` | string | Required. Must not be empty. | `AES-256 encryption for all PII-carrying data stores.` |
| `deadline` | integer | Enter the deadline in Epoch format. | `1743465600000` |
| `expires_at` | integer | Enter the expiry date in Epoch format. | `1775001600000` |
| `state` | string | One of NOT_IMPLEMENTED, IN_PROGRESS, IN_REVIEW, IMPLEMENTED, EXPIRED. Defaults to NOT_IMPLEMENTED. | `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` |
| `effectiveness_rating` | object | `x_value` is severity, `y_value` is likelihood. Bounds depend on tenant risk heatmap settings. `y_value` is forced to 0 in Linear mode. A value of 0 is a valid rating, not unset. | `{"x_value": 3, "y_value": 2}` |
| `compliance_frameworks` | object | `{add: [{id}]}`. Non-system-defined frameworks must share the control's org unit. | `{"add": [{"id": "iso-27001"}]}` |
| `compliance_control` | object | `{id}`. Pass an empty string as the ID to clear an existing link. | `{"id": "cc-pci-3.1"}` |
| `owners` | object | `{add: [{user: {email}}]}`. If the email doesn't match an existing user, Securiti auto-provisions a guest account. | `{"add": [{"user": {"email": "john.doe@securiti.ai"}}]}` |
| `reviewers` | object | `{add: [{user: {email}}]}`. Must be an existing non-guest user in the same org unit. Not auto-provisioned. | `{"add": [{"user": {"email": "john.doe@securiti.ai"}}]}` |
| `risks` | object | `{add: [{id}]}`. A risk can also be linked from the risk's own details. | `{"add": [{"id": 17}]}` |
| `attachments` | object | `{add: [{id}]}`. Upload the file first using Upload Attachment, then link it here by ID. | `{"add": [{"id": 7}]}` |
| `links` | object | `{add: [{url}]}`. | `{"add": [{"url": "https://wiki.example.com/policy"}]}` |
| `tags` | object | `{add: [{tag_id, value_id?, value_text?}]}`. Use value_id for a predefined tag value, value_text for free text. | `{"add": [{"tag_id": "...", "value_id": "..."}]}` |
| `org_unit_id` | integer | Defaults to the caller's active org unit. | `1` |

Enqueues an asynchronous export of controls to a CSV file. Securiti emails the file to the caller once it's ready. Guest users can't export controls.

## Request body parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ids` | array of integers | Enter the control IDs to export. Omit to export all controls. | `[42, 43]` |

Enqueues an asynchronous task that bundles a control's attachments, comment attachments, and links into a zip file. Securiti emails a download link to the caller once it's ready. Guest users can't export evidence.

## Request body parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `control_id` | integer | Required. Enter the control ID whose evidence to export. | `42` |
| `include_controls` | boolean | Include control-level attachments. | `true` |
| `include_comments` | boolean | Include comment-level attachments. | `true` |
| `include_links` | boolean | Include links as a CSV file. | `true` |
| `arrangement` | string | flat (all files in root) or nested (controls/, comments/, links/ sub-folders). Defaults to flat. | `nested` |
| `control_attachment_ids` | array of integers | Has no effect unless include_controls is true. Omit to include all. | `[7, 8]` |
| `comment_attachment_ids` | array of integers | Has no effect unless include_comments is true. Omit to include all. | `[15, 16]` |
| `link_ids` | array of integers | Has no effect unless include_links is true. Omit to include all. | `[11, 12]` |
